newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND INTRODUCES NEW WIBID/WIBOR FIXING RULES.
newsitem.headline: POLAND INTRODUCES NEW WIBID/WIBOR FIXING RULES.

text.p: Polish Bank Dealers' Association, Forex-Poland, introduced on Monday new rules of setting the interbank deposit bid and offer rates (WIBID/WIBOR), a Forex-Poland official said on Monday.
"The new rules of quoting the WIBID/WIBOR are effective for the whole market as of today," Andrzej Rzysko, Forex's secretary, told Reuters.

Under the new system WIBID/WIBOR calculations will be based on the mean average of bids and offers from 17 banks which had been awarded a money market dealer status by the central bank without the two highest and lowest rates.
Under the old system the rates were taken from 15 banks volunteers without cutting the extreme quotings.

The new WIBID/WIBOR will be calculated for tomorrow/next, one-week, one-, three and six month deposits. The new rules drop the previously calculated overnight, spot/next two-week and two-months rates.
For 30 minutes after the fixing, which is at 1100 (1000 GMT), the contributing banks are obliged to make deals at the same or better rates as contributed.
